lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Adult background specimen exhibits 11 high-contrast vertical line segments with non-uniform spacing. Foreground juvenile specimen exhibits 12 vertical line segments with tighter, more consistent inter-line spacing.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Adult specimen: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the third anterior stripe. Foreground specimen: null
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Adult specimen: The first anterior stripe is a partial segment terminating before the mid-torso line. Foreground specimen: Posterior stripes appear as dashed segments near the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Adult specimen: Cluster of 6 white spots on the lower posterior haunch. Foreground specimen: Density of 3 spots on the lateral hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Adult specimen: Three spots on the lateral haunch align to form a semi-horizontal geometric line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Adult specimen is fitted with a wide brown synthetic collar featuring a metallic bronze-colored bell/sensor housing.
other_distinctive_markers: Both specimens display white chevrons between the ocular orbits and white transverse bands on the lower limbs.
